login.title: Organizer log in
login.note: Cooks and guests don't log in here — they get a personalized link by email for each challenge.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.success: Password changed. Log in with your new password.

link.headline: This link is no longer valid
link.body: Your personalized access link has expired. Contact the organizer and ask them to resend your link for this challenge.

qr.headline: This QR code is no longer valid
qr.body: The registration QR code for this cook-off has expired. Ask the organizer to show a fresh code or send you a personalized link by email.

reset.headline: This reset link is no longer valid
reset.body: Password reset links work once and expire after 2 hours, and a newer reset replaces older ones. Ask an admin to send you a new link.

register.title: Register
register.joined: You're registered! You'll get an email once the organizer opens scoring for this cook-off.
register.closed: You're registered, but this event has already closed.

home.emptyOpen: Nothing open right now — check back after the next cook-off.

pickColor.title: Plate under {{color}}?
pickColor.message: This locks your plate color for this challenge and assigns the other cook the remaining color automatically. This can't be changed afterward.

participantCard.ownColorAfter: — noted for guests once scoring opens.

rivalry.title: Rivalry
rivalry.empty: No revealed challenges yet — rivalries build up once results come in.

blindScoring.successBody: Results reveal once the host closes scoring.
blindScoring.revealed: This challenge has been revealed — scoring is closed.
blindScoring.closedBanner: Scoring is closed — results coming soon
blindScoring.instructions: Blind tasting — rate the {{firstLower}} plate and the {{secondLower}} plate, 1–5 stars each, without knowing who cooked which.
blindScoring.gridLabel: Blind scoring — one row per category

history.title: Challenges
history.empty: No challenges yet — start your first cook-off.

challengeDetail.unrevealHint: Made a mistake? You can hide the results again (scoring stays closed).
challengeDetail.deleteHint: Deleting removes this challenge from all lists and from the rivalry record.

closeDialog.title: Close scoring?
closeDialog.message: Guests can no longer submit or edit scores.

revealDialog.title: Reveal this challenge?
revealDialog.message: Revealing shows cook identities and computes results. You can hide them again later if you need to.

unrevealDialog.title: Unreveal this challenge?
unrevealDialog.message: This hides the cook-to-dish mapping again. Scoring stays closed — guests will see it as pending until you reveal it again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this challenge?
deleteDialog.message: The challenge disappears for everyone and no longer counts toward rivalries. This cannot be undone from the app.

sendLinks.title: Send / resend links
sendLinks.hint: Choose who should get (or re-get) their personalized access link by email.

newChallenge.title: New challenge
newChallenge.drop: Drop a 4:3 photo for this rivalry

qrDialog.title: Scan to register
qrDialog.hint: Guests scan this to register for the app and join {{name}}.

resetDialog.title: Reset password?
resetDialog.message: {{name}} gets an email with a link to set a new password. The link works once, for 2 hours, and replaces any earlier reset link.

editAccount.passwordHint: Required for Organizer/Admin roles; ignored otherwise.
